task: Phase 6 Part 1: official Brain2Qwerty v1 model audit
formulation: Per-keystroke classification, not sequence transduction. Every keystroke window is encoded independently, keystrokes are grouped by sentence for a transformer, and each keystroke is classified into one of 29 characters. No CTC, no blank.

input.neural_tensor: (B, 306, 25): one keystroke window [-0.2, +0.3) s at 50 Hz, channels-first

channel_positions.extractor: ChannelPositions2D (official subclass re-enabling 2D layouts for MEG)
channel_positions.normalization: min-max to [0, 1] per dimension; channels without a layout position set to -0.1 and masked
channel_positions.use: Fourier-embedded (2D, 32 frequencies per dimension -> 2048 features) and used as keys of the per-subject spatial attention in the ChannelMerger

subject_conditioning.subject_id: LabelEncoder over the Meg events' subject field, shape (B, 1); 0 for S22
subject_conditioning.channel_merger: per_subject=True: heads (n_subjects=200, 270, 2048) selected by subject id
subject_conditioning.subject_layers: subject_layers_config={} in the official config parses to an enabled SubjectLayers with defaults: a per-subject 512->2048 linear map, weights (200, 512, 2048) + bias (200, 2048)

stages: input dropout 0.2 is applied to the first conv layer's input
ChannelMerger: 306 sensors -> 270 virtual channels via Fourier-position spatial attention (spatial dropout radius 0.2; usage_penalty 1.0 is computed but BrainModule never adds it to the loss)

ConvSequence: 8 x Conv1d 2048 -> 2048, kernel 3, dilations 1,2,4,1,2,4,1,2 (growth 2, period 3), BatchNorm, GELU (gelu=True overrides relu_leakiness), dropout 0.5, residual skip with LayerScale 0.1, no activation after the last layer
time aggregation: Bahdanau attention (hidden 256) over the 25 samples -> one 2048-d vector

sentence_model.unspecified_settings_take_class_defaults: the official config sets only alibi_pos_bias, depth and heads, so use_scalenorm=True, rotary_pos_emb=True, attn_dropout=0.1, ff_mult=4 and scale_residual=True apply
sentence_model.grouping: BrainModule._transformer_forward groups the keystrokes of a batch by sentence_UID, pads, masks and runs the encoder. Grouping is within a batch only.

target_and_loss.target: official LabelEncoder over Keystroke.button with BUTTON_MAPPING: 29 classes (letters, space, <special>, <number>; rare symbols fold into <special>)
target_and_loss.relation_to_neuroselect_vocab: official class = NeuroSelect SpanishBCBL id - 1 (no blank)
target_and_loss.head: Linear(2048, 29)
target_and_loss.loss: CrossEntropyLoss over keystrokes (mean over the batch)

decoding.procedure: argmax per keystroke -> CHAR_INDEX; exactly one character per keystroke
decoding.consequence: The decoder is given the keystroke segmentation: output length always equals the number of keystrokes. Its CER is therefore not comparable with CTC CER, which must infer length.
decoding.language_model: optional KenLM beam search is a separate post-processing script, not part of training

train_validation_test.splitter: Brain2QwertyV1Splitter: 80/10/10 by keystrokes over 19 pooled participants, TF-IDF cosine > 0.5 sentence clusters kept in one split, cluster order shuffled with seed 1
train_validation_test.sampler: SentenceGroupedDistributedSampler without shuffling: fixed sentence order every epoch; with 64-keystroke batches, sentences straddling a batch boundary reach the transformer in two parts
train_validation_test.checkpointing: best val_CER checkpoint saved, but trainer.test runs on the final in-memory weights
train_validation_test.official_cer_metric: Levenshtein over each batch concatenated into one string, normalized per batch (not per sentence, despite its docstring)

optimization.scheduler: OneCycleLR, max_lr 5e-5, pct_start 0.1, stepped per batch
optimization.devices: 8 GPUs by default; CPU fallback when CUDA is absent

corrections_to_earlier_audit.rotary_positional_embedding: earlier: false. Measured: RotaryEmbedding is active alongside ALiBi.
corrections_to_earlier_audit.subject_layers: earlier audit did not record them. Measured: 210,124,800 parameters.
